Upper Text: [On Play] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ all of your opponent's Digimon. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 5 or less. If no Digimon is deleted by this effect, none of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon can digivolve until the end of your opponent's turn.
[Opponent's Turn] While you have a Tamer in play, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ and ＜Reboot＞.
